parts.style: calm, reverent, reading scripture aloud slowly
parts.text: And we know that all things work together for good to them that love God, to them who are the called according to his purpose. <short pause> Romans, chapter eight, verse twenty-eight.

Father, even the hard and confusing parts of my life are not beyond Your reach. <short pause> You work all things together for good because I am Yours. <short pause> I may not see the pattern yet, but I trust Your loving purpose as I close my eyes tonight. <short pause> Amen.
